description: tonyd2wild's DSpark Inkling Small profile on two Sparks: thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small-NVFP4 on vLLM tensor parallel 2 (mp, as eugr's launcher does by default) with RadixArk's BF16 Inkling-Small-DSpark-Preview draft (seven speculative tokens, draft TP 2), InstantTensor loading for the target and lazy safetensors for the draft, a 262,144-token context, BF16 KV cache and CUDA graphs disabled (upstream hit an illegal memory access in Inkling short-convolution metadata during graph capture). Image: eugr's published spark-vllm image (digest-pinned, built from eugr/spark-vllm-docker 60dee5b4) with upstream's mods applied at build time: eugr's inkling-sm12-paged-kv and instanttensor-hybrid-draft-loader, and tonyd2wild's parser fix, audio dependencies (four pinned wheels), DSpark hidden-state exposure, warmup cap and prefill-admission cap. eugr's launch-cluster.sh at 60dee5b4 also exports NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 and PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True into every container (lines 10-11), and the recipe sets both, as the creator's verified runs had them. The draft's vLLM config overlay is generated at build time by upstream's own prepare script from the pinned config.json. Upstream caps concurrency at five: C1 to C5 passed its sustained benchmarks and C6 reproducibly deadlocks the worker in sample_tokens on this vLLM build. Same-creator alternative for this model and Spark count: the MTP recipe. Licences (information only): model Apache-2.0; the draft repository declares no licence (research preview); eugr's runtime and mods MIT with a bundled FA4 package under its own licence; tonyd2wild's repository states that no licence has been selected. Upstream figures (about 25 tok/s at C1 and 62 tok/s aggregate at C5 on its Bluey and Spark4 pair, DSpark acceptance about 13 percent) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 and the 262,144-token context, as in tonyd2wild's recipes/inkling-small-nvfp4-mounted-dspark.yaml at 7795dd3a (lines 23-24); upstream's results document 79.38 GiB of model memory and 13.95 GiB of KV (316,477 tokens, 1.21 times the full context) per rank inside that budget. The creator-settings floor is 0.8 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (the speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the declared steady peak is the measured value below; the reserve is 8 GB, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. The load peak is the Controller-observed whole-run peak of the 2026-10-25 run of this recipe's previous content: 127,251,378,176 bytes on the entrypoint and 127,039,012,864 bytes on the worker. Those are sampled, so lower bounds; the 2026-10-29 start showed the same roughly 126 GB in use at 76 percent of the InstantTensor load. The overshoot above the steady peak is host pages the kernel displaces to swap while pinned CUDA memory stays resident, so the recipe declares 17,179,869,184 bytes (16 GiB) of minimum swap. Upstream's earlyoom and drop-caches are covered by the platform memory guard and the helper's page-cache drops. Measured peak (hardware sweep 2026-10-31T05:54:58Z, run alone, Controller node telemetry, OS included): entrypoint 120,888,324,096 and worker 119,142,985,728 bytes in use (a single post-smoke sample, so a lower bound of the steady peak); the declared peaks are the in-use bytes less the 2 GiB OS allowance, never lower than before: entrypoint 118,740,840,448, worker 116,995,502,080.
title: Inkling Small NVFP4 DSpark vLLM two Sparks (tonyd2wild)
